notes: Lead: Senior product engineering org building a conversational insights layer for B2B SaaS customers. Wants predictable throughput and lower per-token cost than Hosted during heavy batch inference. Evaluated Hosted API: good dev velocity, but spikes in daily traffic increase cost. Interested in pinning model versions and using Dedicated for consistent latency. Security/compliance flagged by InfoSec: need VPC option + audit logs + KMS. SE call notes: 'we need canary + rollback on model change, and region failover if eu nodes unavailable' — quoted from Dir of Engineering.
poc_plan: 6-week Dedicated POC. Week 0: infra prep & contract (legal/SOW). Week 1-2: deploy Dedicated pool (1x p4d-equivalent), integrate VPC peering and KMS. Week 3: canary traffic (1% -> 10% -> 30%) against a subset of customers for chat and reranking. Week 4-5: stress throughput tests, batch workloads for nightly embeddings, observe cost and SLOs. Week 6: cutover runbook review, rollback rehearsals, security sign-off and final pricing negotiation.
canary_strategy: Start with model-variant canary: route 1% of chat traffic to optimized quantized variant (same topology) with telemetry. Ramp to 10% over 48h if 95th pct latency and error rate within thresholds. Automated rollback trigger on: error_rate > 1.0%, 95th pct latency > 300ms, or quality regression on a holdout eval set. SE to instrument KV cache hit metrics and token-level cost reports.
fallback_routing: Primary routing: Dedicated pool in us-east. Fallback sequence: 1) auto-fallback to equivalent Dedicated capacity in us-west 2) if Dedicated capacity unavailable, route to Hosted API with model variant tuned for cost (soft-fallback) 3) in cross-region failover, preserve customer data residency flags by only failing over for non-EU traffic. Rollback policy: immediate traffic cutback to Hosted with circuit-breaker if health-checks fail for 3 consecutive minutes.
pricing_notes: Initial quote for Dedicated POC: blended estimate $60k/month (reserved small pool) with POC discount. Licensing levers: committed throughput hours, optional reserved burst capacity. Finance wants a 90-day evaluation spend cap before auto-authorization for additional capacity.
use_case_summary: Customer wants an in-product chat assistant + document search and ranking for power users. Key requirements: sub-250ms 95th latency for chat, bulk nightly embedding job for analytics, model-version pinning, and canary + rollback workflows. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit if Dedicated yields >30% unit cost savings vs Hosted at scale.
